segments.sensitive: One reviewer with self-described super sensitive skin reports the patches work without causing harm or triggering new breakouts.

concerns.spots: Many reviewers describe the patches flattening or shrinking individual pimples and whiteheads overnight or within a few hours, and several say they bring a stubborn pimple to the surface over one to two nights; effectiveness on cystic pimples is described as weaker, with one reviewer noting they work best on regular blemishes/whiteheads rather than cystic ones, and two reviewers (i2, i7) say the patches did nothing even on fresh whiteheads or after 6+ hours.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts and faster healing with regular use, including one who says acne cleared within about a week, though one reviewer says the patch did not empty or heal the pore and just covered it.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports reduced redness and dark spots with use, and another reports a pimple's redness and size reduced after a second night's application.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states the patch helped her skin maintain its moisture barrier when it was already compromised.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers describe the patches drawing out oil, gunk, or impurities from pores, though one reviewer with a similar aim found it did not extract as well as competitor brands.

extraits.texte: Does not stick to clean/dry skin. Doesnt even stay on for 1 hour. Impossible to peel off the back sheet without them folding.

At first I was in love with these. I get breakouts and pimples often and they cleared them overnight. They were easy to find, for I could go to my local drug store. But when I went to peel them off, they were stuck. My eyes were watering, and I ended up having to soak them off with water. I am on my 5th pack only because they clear pimples so quickly, but if you are looking for a easy removing pimple patch, I wouldn't recommend these.
They're cute but feel just like a regular sticker. I dont see or feel any hydrocolloid on the sticker. Total waste of money. Going back to the Mighty Patch. Way better at absorbing.

can't forget the og star of starface! works great, looks bright and cute and helps stop hands that can't help but want to pick! also as someone who has super sensitive skin, I LOVE that starface stars get the job done without doing any harm or causing my skin to breakout more. 100% love this product!

These are the best pimple patches ever, I always keep a supply of starface on hand. They're not quite as effective for cystic pimples, I find they work best on regular blemishes/whiteheads. They really help speed up the healing process and prevent scarring.

The OG for a reason. The hydro-star has the best grip of all the stars I've tried. It stays on the skin until the spot starts healing and then loosens up naturally so I know when to take it off. It has great coverage and helps my skin maintain its moisture barrier when it's already suffering. I love how I can wear these out and feel confident that I still look good.

I've had a pimple that didn't want to come to the surface for a few days and used a Starface overnight. The pimple came to the surface slowly, then I used another patch the next night and it helped reduce it by redness and size. It was gone within two days!
